ValidationRule.description: Prevent a user from entering a Case ID if its not required to enter.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(IDN_CASE__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(CDE_REJECT_APPLN__c, "1")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(CDE_REJECT_APPLN__c, "3")), ISPICKVAL(CDE_SOURCE__c, "PK"), PEAK_bypass_CaseID_Validation__c == false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please do not enter Case ID unless PEAK Application is in Rejected status.
